Indiana Pacers — injuries
Indiana recalled McConnell (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Saturday.
McConnell has been unavailable throughout the first few games of the campaign due to his issue but could be close to making a comeback for the parent team following a short stint with Noblesville. The experienced guard was quite active last season despite coming off the second unit in most of his outings, and a similar situation may be expected this campaign as soon as he's cleared to see action.
